Metadata for netData

Source: R/data.r
metadata.Rd

A data.frame with extended information about the 29 networks from (1), included in netData

Usage

metadata

Format

A data frame

Network

Name of the network

Longitude

Longitude of the geographical coordinates of the network

Latitude

Latitude of the geographical coordinates of the network

Date

Date range or approximate date when the data was collected

InteractionsSource

Method used to determine the interactions

Reference

Reference of the study from where data was obtained

ReferenceLink

URL of the reference

Source

https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0198217

  1. Marina, T. I., Saravia, L. A., Cordone, G., Salinas, V., Doyle, S. R., & Momo, F. R. (2018). Architecture of marine food webs: To be or not be a ‘small-world.’ PLoS ONE, 13(5), 1–13. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0198217
